description: This file contains a Python class `VertexAIRAGTransformation` that provides utility methods for transforming data and constructing requests relevant to Google Cloud's Vertex AI RAG Engine. It includes functions for URL construction, chunking strategy transformations, request payload building, and authentication handling.

classes.name: VertexAIRAGTransformation
classes.description: A class providing methods for transforming chunking strategies, constructing import requests, and managing authentication for Vertex AI RAG Engine.

methods.name: str get_import_rag_files_url( self, vertex_project: str, vertex_location: str, corpus_id: str, )
methods.description: Constructs the URL for importing RAG files into Vertex AI, given project, location, and corpus ID.

methods.name: str get_retrieve_contexts_url( self, vertex_project: str, vertex_location: str, )
methods.description: Constructs the URL for retrieving contexts from Vertex AI in the specified project and location.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] transform_chunking_strategy_to_vertex_format( self, chunking_strategy: Optional[RAGChunkingStrategy], )
methods.description: Transforms a unified chunking strategy into the format expected by Vertex AI RAG Engine, translating chunk size and overlap, and warning if separators are provided.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] build_import_rag_files_request( self, gcs_uri: str, chunking_strategy: Optional[RAGChunkingStrategy] = None, )
methods.description: Builds the request payload for importing RAG files, including GCS source URI and optional chunking strategy.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] get_auth_headers( self, vertex_credentials: Optional[str] = None, vertex_project: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Obtains authentication headers for Vertex AI API calls, managing credentials and access tokens.
